INPUT: {"task": "Ship the hotfix: `ssh prod bash -s < deploy/remote-deploy.sh`; the script runs `docker compose run --rm migrate` and then `docker compose up -d api worker`.", "lessons": [{"id": "R1", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The deploy stopped the writers before taking the backup; when the S3 upload failed the production stack stayed down.

## Fix
Take and verify the backup BEFORE stopping api/worker; stop writers only after the backup succeeded.

## Context
remote-deploy.sh order."}, {"id": "R2", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
deploy.sh piped the remote script into `ssh host bash -s`; `docker compose exec -T db pg_dump` and `docker compose run --rm migrate` inside it read stdin and swallowed the rest of the script, so the first deploy exited 0 with the app never started.

## Fix
Never let a command inside a script piped to `bash -s` read stdin: give it `</dev/null` (or copy the script to the host and run the file).

## Context
Reproduced with `printf 'echo a\ncat>/dev/null\necho b\n' | bash -s` printing only `a`."}, {"id": "R3", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
An `ssh` inside a `while read ...; do ...; done < hosts.txt` loop (and inside a heredoc script) read the loop's stdin, so the loop stopped after the first host.

## Fix
Use `ssh -n` (or `< /dev/null`) for every ssh call inside a read loop or heredoc.

## Context
Same stdin-swallowing class as the bash -s deploy bug."}, {"id": "R4", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
`ssh host 'pkill -f hlmemo.worker'` killed the ssh session itself, because the remote shell's own command line contains the pattern.

## Fix
Stop processes by pidfile, `systemctl`/`docker` or `pgrep -f` with an anchored pattern that cannot match the ssh command line.

## Context
Seen while stopping a stuck import on the VPS."}, {"id": "R5", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The deploy runner uses `umask 077`, so the checkout was 0600 and the worker container (uid 10001) could not read its bind-mounted entrypoint: crash loop on the first real deploy.

## Fix
After every checkout (and every rollback checkout) make each bind-mounted file group/other-readable; add any new bind-mounted file to that list.

## Context
Found in the lima rehearsal; local gates could not see it."}, {"id": "R6", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
pytest was run without HLM_TEST_DSN; the conftest fell back to the compose `hlm` dev database and its autouse fixture truncated every table, wiping the corpus-A import.

## Fix
Always export HLM_TEST_DSN pointing at a disposable database (hlm_test_<ws>) before any pytest run; the conftest now refuses the protected `hlm` database.

## Context
Incident 2026-09-23 10:02 UTC during the D-055 verification round."}, {"id": "R7", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The pre-commit gitleaks hook flagged a test fixture full of fake high-entropy tokens and the commit was forced through with `git commit --no-verify`.

## Fix
Add a narrow allowlist entry for that one fixture path in the gitleaks config and commit normally; never bypass the hook and never disable the scanner.

## Context
The repository is public (D-011); the hook is the secret gate."}, {"id": "R8", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
An implementer applied a new migration to the shared dev database `hlm`; the running dev API answered /ready 503 for hours.

## Fix
Implementer agents migrate and test only on their own hlm_test_<ws> database; hlm, hlm_verify and hlm_retr are off-limits (read-only dump at most).

## Context
Process violation noted in D-055."}, {"id": "R9", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
restore.sh started the app with `up --no-deps`, skipping the migrate service, so current code ran on an older schema.

## Fix
A restore must run the migrations (alembic upgrade main@head) before starting api/worker.

## Context
Backup/restore drill."}]}

## Context
Seen while stopping a stuck import on the VPS."}, {"id": "R4", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
In zsh `grep -rn foo src --include=*.py` failed with `no matches found: --include=*.py` and grep never ran, because an unquoted glob that matches nothing is an error in zsh.

## Fix
Quote glob patterns meant for the program: `--include='*.py'`.

## Context
Happens in zsh one-liners run by agents on macOS."}, {"id": "R5", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
`docker compose down -v` was used to restart a stack and also deleted the named pgdata volume with an expensive import in it.

## Fix
Use `docker compose down` (without -v) on any stack whose database matters; -v only for truly disposable stacks.

## Context
-v removes named volumes declared in the compose file."}, {"id": "R6", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
compose published Postgres on all interfaces (0.0.0.0:5432) with the default hlm/hlm credentials.

## Fix
Bind Postgres to 127.0.0.1 locally and never publish it in production; reach it through an SSH tunnel.

## Context
Security finding S4 of the Phase-0 review."}, {"id": "R7", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The worker logged its DSN including the database password.

## Fix
Never log DSNs or URLs with credentials; log host/db only or redact the password.

## Context
Found in the Phase-0 final audit."}, {"id": "R8", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
`git add -A` in a tree that holds hlm.toml, .env and device tokens nearly pushed private deployment config into the public repository.

Stage explicit paths; keep only the example files (hlm.example.toml) tracked; private config lives in the private ops repo.

## Context
Public repo github.com/NeverGET/HLMemo."}, {"id": "R9", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
In a zsh script `FLAGS="--frozen --extra dev"; uv sync $FLAGS` passed ONE argument with spaces, because zsh does not word-split unquoted parameter expansions.

## Fix
Use an array (`flags=(--frozen --extra dev); cmd "${flags[@]}"`) or `${=FLAGS}` in zsh.

## Context
bash splits the same line; the bug only appears under zsh (macOS default shell)."}]}

## Fix
Set ORT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 in every process that loads the embedder (API, worker, CLIs, test runs) before onnxruntime is imported.

## Context
Root-caused from Apple crash reports."}, {"id": "R2", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
pytest was run without HLM_TEST_DSN; the conftest fell back to the compose `hlm` dev database and its autouse fixture truncated every table, wiping the corpus-A import.

## Fix
Always export HLM_TEST_DSN pointing at a disposable database (hlm_test_<ws>) before any pytest run; the conftest now refuses the protected `hlm` database.

## Context
Incident 2026-09-23 10:02 UTC during the D-055 verification round."}, {"id": "R3", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
An implementer applied a new migration to the shared dev database `hlm`; the running dev API answered /ready 503 for hours.

## Fix
Implementer agents migrate and test only on their own hlm_test_<ws> database; hlm, hlm_verify and hlm_retr are off-limits (read-only dump at most).

## Context
Process violation noted in D-055."}, {"id": "R4", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
A failed deploy left the hlmemo:prod image tag pointing at the failed release, so a later restore/up ran the failed code.

## Fix
Retag the production image only after the release is accepted; on failure restore the previous tag.

## Context
deploy runner image tagging."}, {"id": "R5", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The deploy runner uses `umask 077`, so the checkout was 0600 and the worker container (uid 10001) could not read its bind-mounted entrypoint: crash loop on the first real deploy.

## Fix
After every checkout (and every rollback checkout) make each bind-mounted file group/other-readable; add any new bind-mounted file to that list.

## Context
Found in the lima rehearsal; local gates could not see it."}, {"id": "R6", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
A CI step ran `pytest -q | tee pytest.log`; pytest failed but the step passed, because `$?` of a pipeline is the status of `tee`.

## Fix
Use `set -o pipefail` (or write to a file and check the command's own exit status).

## Context
Applies to any `cmd | tee` or `cmd | tail` whose status matters."}, {"id": "R7", "project": "rk-shell", "text": "## Mistake
`ssh host 'pkill -f hlmemo.worker'` killed the ssh session itself, because the remote shell's own command line contains the pattern.

## Fix
Stop processes by pidfile, `systemctl`/`docker` or `pgrep -f` with an anchored pattern that cannot match the ssh command line.

## Context
Seen while stopping a stuck import on the VPS."}, {"id": "R8", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
The pre-commit gitleaks hook flagged a test fixture full of fake high-entropy tokens and the commit was forced through with `git commit --no-verify`.

## Fix
Add a narrow allowlist entry for that one fixture path in the gitleaks config and commit normally; never bypass the hook and never disable the scanner.

## Context
The repository is public (D-011); the hook is the secret gate."}, {"id": "R9", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
Switching the embedding model was planned as a DDL change of embeddings.vec to a new vector(N) type.

## Fix
A model switch is a re-embed job: vectors are untyped with dims and model@revision per row, and the ANN index is a per-model partial index.

## Context
D-017 provider-agnostic embeddings."}, {"id": "R10", "project": "rk-main", "text": "## Mistake
Changing how the idempotency request hash is computed broke retries of events written before the upgrade: the retry no longer matched and got E_REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT.

## Fix
Version the hash algorithm, store the version on the event and use the recorded version when a retry is compared.

## Context
write_service hash_version."}]}
